recs.stt: ‘Green growth’ doesn’t exist – less of everything only way to avert catastrophe
recs.x: Here's a fascinating talk by Václav Smil at the Driva Climate Investment Meeting in 2019: [link]

I recall Vaclav Smil saying batteries are consistently about 2-3% per year over the long haul. It's not a Moore's law scenario, but a very slow crawl. "Miracles might happen," he says, "but would I bet on a miracle happening? No."

This link is to the point in the video where he says this, but the whole talk is quite interesting.
